entries.singular: Unlike learning spells, psionics are not guaranteed.  Each newly-created character has only a chance to gain powers.  This chance is variable per character, set when your character is created, and can range from 50% to as little as 1%.  Furthermore, every path you learn decreases your odds to learn future paths, though it never becomes impossible.  You may take the Latent Psion trait at character creation to ensure that your first attempt to awaken psionic powers is always successful, but this does affect the diminishing returns of attempting to awaken additional paths.  You do not need to take this straight if you start the game with any type of psionic powers; starting psions are assumed to have been latent.

translations.0: 呪文の習得とは異なり、超能力は必ず習得に成功するわけではありません。新規作成した各キャラクターには習得成功率が設定されています。この確率は、50%から1%の範囲でゲーム開始時に決まります。更に、習得している超能力の分野が多いほど、新たな分野の超能力の習得に成功する確率は下がります。しかし習得が完全に不可能になることはありません。キャラクター作成時に「潜在的超能力者」の特質を取得しておけば、ゲーム開始後初めての超能力習得に必ず成功しますが、これも今後異なる分野の超能力を習得する際の成功率低下の要因となります。既に超能力を習得済みのキャラクターで開始する場合は、新分野の習得成功率低下は引き起こされません。開始時に習得している力は先天的なものと想定されているためです。

This chance is variable per character, set when your character is created, and can range from 50% to as little as 1%.  Furthermore, every path you learn decreases your odds to learn future paths, though it never becomes impossible.  You may take the Latent Psion trait at character creation to ensure that your first attempt to awaken psionic powers is always successful, but this does affect the diminishing returns of attempting to awaken additional paths.  You do not need to take this straight if you start the game with any type of psionic powers; starting psions are assumed to have been latent."]

"Now, I have no use for such a thing, but perhaps you do.  What do you say?  It's yours for 3 coins."
